name: sne.space WebMCP Browser Agent
description: In-browser WebMCP declarative and imperative tools exposing interactive supernova search, multi-band photometry extraction, and spatial coordinate cone search across 110,000+ supernovae.

skills.name: Supernova Search
skills.description: Search 110,000+ supernovae and transients by IAU designation, name, or survey alias (e.g. SN 2023ixf, SN 1987A, SN 2011fe, AT2024nrb)

skills.name: Supernova Data Retrieval
skills.description: Retrieve complete astrophysical JSON metadata, coordinates, classification, redshift, and discovery details for a specific supernova

skills.name: Spatial Cone Search
skills.description: Spatial cone search for supernovae within an angular radius around J2000 celestial coordinates (Right Ascension & Declination in degrees)
